— 5/100

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.1 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.1 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 14.7 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 14.7 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 10,270 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (10,270 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.594

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.594). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 17.1 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (17.1 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.6 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.0 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 2,020 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (2,020 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 6.0 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (6.0 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.5 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.5 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.2 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.2 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 390 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (390 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 6.1 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (6.1 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Use efficient cache lifetimes

Result: Est savings of 43 KiB

Why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 43 KiB for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

How to fix: Consider setting [font-display](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/font-display) to swap or optional to ensure text is consistently visible. swap can be further optimized to mitigate layout shifts with [font metric overrides](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/font-fallbacks).

Legacy JavaScript

Result: Est savings of 6 KiB

Why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 6 KiB for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.

How to fix: Polyfills and transforms enable older browsers to use new JavaScript features. However, many aren't necessary for modern browsers. Consider modifying your JavaScript build process to not transpile [Baseline](https://web.dev/articles/baseline-and-polyfills) features, unless you know you must support older browsers. [Learn why most sites can deploy ES6+ code without transpiling](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/legacy-javascript)

Network dependency tree

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: [Avoid chaining critical requests](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/network-dependency-tree) by reducing the length of chains, reducing the download size of resources, or deferring the download of unnecessary resources to improve page load.

Render-blocking requests

Result: Est savings of 1,010 ms

Why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 1,010 ms for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.

How to fix: Requests are blocking the page's initial render, which may delay LCP. [Deferring or inlining](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/render-blocking) can move these network requests out of the critical path.

Max Potential First Input Delay

Why: Lighthouse reported 380 ms for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 2.6 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 2.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.4 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.4 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,080 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,080 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.127

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.127). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 3.7 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (3.7 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Use efficient cache lifetimes

Result: Est savings of 43 KiB

Why: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 43 KiB for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: Properly ordered headings that do not skip levels convey the semantic structure of the page, making it easier to navigate and understand when using assistive technologies. [Learn more about heading order](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/heading-order).

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.2 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.2 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.5 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.5 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 2,910 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (2,910 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 7.6 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.6 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.6 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.9 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.9 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 3,710 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (3,710 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.134

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.134). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 7.8 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.8 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Use efficient cache lifetimes

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.5 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.5 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.5 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.5 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,460 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,460 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 6.0 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (6.0 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.8 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.8 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 14.5 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 14.5 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,650 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,650 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 7.6 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.6 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.2 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.2 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.0 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 2,030 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (2,030 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 5.4 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.4 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 2.4 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 2.4 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 3.0 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 3.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 2,020 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (2,020 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.31

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.31). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 4.2 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (4.2 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 2.8 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 2.8 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.9 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.9 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 3,150 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (3,150 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.107

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.107). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 5.6 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.6 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.2 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.2 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.0 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,830 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,830 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 4.5 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (4.5 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.1 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.1 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 960 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (960 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.232

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.232). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 4.3 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (4.3 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.4 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.4 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.2 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.2 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,640 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,640 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.187

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.187). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 7.7 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.7 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.3 s

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 3.8 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 3.8 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,290 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,290 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.169

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.169). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 4.4 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (4.4 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 2.6 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 2.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 3.6 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 3.6 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,110 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,110 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.182

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.182). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 5.7 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.7 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Performance — 5/100

Page: https://bbgs.in/

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.1 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.1 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 14.7 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 14.7 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 10,270 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (10,270 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.594

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.594). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 17.1 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (17.1 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

How to fix: Layout shifts occur when elements move absent any user interaction. [Investigate the causes of layout shifts](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cls-culprit), such as elements being added, removed, or their fonts changing as the page loads.

Forced reflow

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: A forced reflow occurs when JavaScript queries geometric properties (such as offsetWidth) after styles have been invalidated by a change to the DOM state. This can result in poor performance. Learn more about [forced reflows](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/forced-reflow) and possible mitigations.

How to fix: Reducing the download time of images can improve the perceived load time of the page and LCP. [Learn more about optimizing image size](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/image-delivery)

LCP breakdown

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: Each [subpart has specific improvement strategies](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/lcp-breakdown). Ideally, most of the LCP time should be spent on loading the resources, not within delays.

Network dependency tree

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: [Avoid chaining critical requests](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/network-dependency-tree) by reducing the length of chains, reducing the download size of resources, or deferring the download of unnecessary resources to improve page load.

Performance — 32/100

Page: https://bbgs.in/who-we-are.php

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.7 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.7 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 12.5 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 12.5 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 2,520 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (2,520 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 7.0 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.0 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Page: https://bbgs.in/hand-dryer.php

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.2 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.2 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 3.6 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 3.6 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 980 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (980 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 5.9 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.9 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

First Contentful Paint

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 3.9 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 3.9 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,350 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,350 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 5.6 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.6 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.6 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.0 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.0 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 2,020 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (2,020 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 6.0 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (6.0 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Performance — 57/100

Page: https://bbgs.in/shoes-shine-machine.php

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.5 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.5 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.2 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.2 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 390 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (390 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 6.1 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (6.1 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Result: Est savings of 43 KiB

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

Why: The main visible content is taking 2.7 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 560 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (560 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.179

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.179). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 4.1 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (4.1 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

Performance — 52/100

Page: https://bbgs.in/anti-skid-tape.php

First Contentful Paint

Result: 2.6 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 2.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 4.4 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 4.4 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,080 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,080 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.127

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.127). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 3.7 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (3.7 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

Performance — 28/100

Page: https://bbgs.in/office-industry.php

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.6 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.9 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.9 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 3,710 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (3,710 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.134

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.134). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 7.8 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.8 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

Performance — 32/100

Page: https://bbgs.in/reach-us.php

First Contentful Paint

Result: 4.8 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 4.8 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 14.5 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 14.5 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,650 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,650 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 7.6 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.6 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Use efficient cache lifetimes

How to fix: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.8 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,670 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,670 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.161

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.161). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 5.5 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.5 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 2.6 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 2.6 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 3.6 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 3.6 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,110 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (1,110 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.182

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.182). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

How to fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

Speed Index

Result: 5.7 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.7 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

How to fix: Set an explicit width and height on image elements to reduce layout shifts and improve CLS. [Learn how to set image dimensions](https://web.dev/articles/optimize-cls#images_without_dimensions)

Affected Elements:

  • div.upper-box > div.nav-logo > a > img
  • div.container > div.logo > a > img
  • div.slider-content > figure.image-box > a.lightbox-image > img.imggg2

Buttons do not have an accessible name

Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: Properly ordered headings that do not skip levels convey the semantic structure of the page, making it easier to navigate and understand when using assistive technologies. [Learn more about heading order](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/heading-order).

Affected Elements:

  • div.row > div.footer-column > div.footer-widget > h5.widget-title

Links do not have a discernible name

Why: One or more links do not have a clear accessible name.

How to fix: Give every meaningful link descriptive visible text or an appropriate accessible name.

  • body > div.page-wrapper > div.redes > a.whatsapp

`[user-scalable="no"]` is used in the `<meta name="viewport">` element or the `[maximum-scale]` attribute is less than 5.

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: Disabling zooming is problematic for users with low vision who rely on screen magnification to properly see the contents of a web page. [Learn more about the viewport meta tag](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/meta-viewport).

Affected Elements:

  • head > meta

Select elements do not have associated label elements.

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: Form elements without effective labels can create frustrating experiences for screen reader users. [Learn more about the `select` element](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/select-name).

Affected Elements:

  • div.row > div.col-sm-12 > div.mb-3 > select.form-control

Document does not have a main landmark.

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: One main landmark helps screen reader users navigate a web page. [Learn more about landmarks](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/landmark-one-main).

Affected Elements:

  • html

Tables do not use `<caption>` instead of cells with the `[colspan]` attribute to indicate a caption.

Why: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.

How to fix: Screen readers have features to make navigating tables easier. Ensuring that tables use the actual caption element instead of cells with the `[colspan]` attribute may improve the experience for screen reader users. [Learn more about captions](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/table-fake-caption).

Affected Elements:

  • div.col-lg-6 > div.col-md-12 > div.table-responsive > table.table
